newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt will send amended bill back.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt will send amended bill back.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday the government would ask the upper house of parliament, the Senate, to reconsider the a bill to exclude immigrants from social security for two years.
The Senate substantially amended the social security bill on Tuesday, in a move which Costello has said will cost the budget A$400 million over the next four years.
"We're going to put that A$400 million back to them (the Senate)," Costello said in a Melbourne radio interview.
"We're going to ask them to reconsider and if they don't reconsider in three months time, we'll put it to them again."
The government can call a double dissolution election once a bill has been rejected twice.
The social security bill amendments will allow newly arrived immigrants to claim many social security entitlements but not unemployment benefits.
